Earlier runs showed that adding detector boxes from the train split (matched to ground truth by IoU > 0.5) as extra training data gives ~+0.004 mAP. This closes the train-test distribution gap for the classifier. I will add these matched detector boxes to the training set alongside the original crops.

The current run uses only two views; adding the third view at both training and inference targets the largest error source with a method that has historical precedent.
